instruction: Let's incorporate the high- and medium-impact findings into our spec. Once they are incorporated. Invoke the council. Very precise with your counsel guidance. We're shooting for a 9.5 for coverage. Have my permission to iterate up to 3 times. After the fourth, stop and ask for my guidance.
scope: Document-only incorporation of nine mandatory compatibility themes plus selected high/medium-impact advisory dispositions; fresh framework-wide design/source-feasibility council and bounded document corrections. No product construction/Gate-A/model/store/delivery actions.

budget.stop: Stop early only if each seat independently VERIFIED with overall and coverage scores >=9.5 and zero mandatory findings. At latest after pass4 stop and ask maintainer guidance; no fifth pass, unlimited reissue or provider substitution. Blocked/incomplete passes count.
budget.explicit_document_only_exception: Maintainer explicitly authorizes up to three corrective document iterations beyond the usual two-cycle escalation; this does not extend to implementation or any wider scope.

low_impact_dispositions: Prior status-summary correction remains; telemetry is explicitly unchanged. No additional low-impact implementation work.

exemption.reason: Explicit maintainer request to revise proposed technical documents and review them; no runtime behavior changes during planning.
exemption.validation: Document/admin, exact path/hash/scope checks, state preservation; future runtime/model proof remains pending.
